title: Scholia v0.6.2 constraint phrase and token-boundary contract
description: Shared positive and negative fixtures for Rule 7. These cases prevent articles and token substrings from being misclassified as forbidden actions while retaining explicit forbidden-verb detection.

cases.description: The article in 'Never a bare null' must not become the forbidden verb 'a'.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Constraint id="C_01">Never a bare null.</Constraint>
  <Action id="A_01">Persist a structured result.<Finding id="F_01">The structured result was persisted.</Finding></Action>
</Step>

cases.description: A forbidden token must not match as a substring inside an unrelated word.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Constraint id="C_01">Never delete records.</Constraint>
  <Action id="A_01">Report the undeleted record count.<Finding id="F_01">The count was reported.</Finding></Action>
</Step>

cases.description: A Constraint only applies after it appears in trace order.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Action id="A_01">Delete the disposable fixture.<Finding id="F_01">The fixture was removed.</Finding></Action>
  <Constraint id="C_01">Never delete fixtures.</Constraint>
</Step>

cases.description: An Action using the explicit forbidden verb after Never is rejected.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Constraint id="C_01">Never delete records.</Constraint>
  <Action id="A_01">Delete the customer records.<Finding id="F_01">The records were deleted.</Finding></Action>
</Step>

cases.description: The 'must not' form detects the explicit forbidden verb.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Constraint id="C_01">Agents must not expose credentials.</Constraint>
  <Action id="A_01">Expose the credentials in the log.<Finding id="F_01">The log contained credentials.</Finding></Action>
</Step>

cases.description: The 'do not' form detects the explicit forbidden verb.
cases.trace:
<Step id="S_01">
  <Constraint id="C_01">Do not overwrite files.</Constraint>
  <Action id="A_01">Overwrite the release file.<Finding id="F_01">The file was overwritten.</Finding></Action>
</Step>
